# Season Shelf 1.2.6

- Added an On/Off preference for download-complete desktop notifications under Settings > Downloads and storage. Changes apply immediately and persist between launches.
- Simplified download summary cards by removing decorative bottom lines and hover movement. The actual batch progress bar remains.
- Channel and search-group selectors focus their text fields when opened. The series-search field also receives focus, and Enter posts the search.
- Reduced bot reply collection from 30 seconds to 15 seconds.
- Softened the light theme with warm stone backgrounds, cream panels, muted sage accents, and gentler shadows while retaining readable text contrast.

Windows installations can update from within the app. On macOS, download the universal DMG and replace the app in Applications. Builds remain unsigned, and the macOS build is not notarized.
